(defprotocol c2pa basic
  (defrole generator0
    (vars (gen name) (media data) (assertions text))
    (trace
      (send
        (cat media (enc (hash assertions (hash media)) (privk gen))
          assertions (hash media)))))
  (defrole generator1
    (vars (gen tsa name) (media data) (assertions time text))
    (trace
      (send (hash (enc (hash assertions (hash media)) (privk gen))))
      (recv
        (cat (hash (enc (hash assertions (hash media)) (privk gen)))
          time
          (enc
            (hash
              (hash (enc (hash assertions (hash media)) (privk gen)))
              time) (privk tsa))))
      (send
        (cat media
          (cat (enc (hash assertions (hash media)) (privk gen))
            assertions (hash media))
          (hash (enc (hash assertions (hash media)) (privk gen))) time
          (enc
            (hash
              (hash (enc (hash assertions (hash media)) (privk gen)))
              time) (privk tsa))))))
  (defrole generator2

                  (privk gen))) time) (privk tsa))))
      (send
        (cat media

            (enc (hash (cat assertions "TS") (hash media)) (privk gen))
            (cat assertions "TS") (hash media))
          (cat
            (hash

                (privk gen))) time

  (defrole generator3

          (cat
            (cat (hash (enc (hash assertions (hash media)) (privk gen)))

                  time) (privk tsa)))

            (hash media)) (hash media)))))
  (defrole generator4
    (vars (gen tsa name) (media data) (assertions time text))

(defskeleton c2pa
  (vars (media data) (assertions text) (gen name))
  (defstrand validator0 1 (media media) (assertions assertions)
    (gen gen))
  (non-orig (privk gen))
  (goals
    (forall ((media data) (assertions text) (gen name) (z strd))
      (implies
        (and (p "validator0" z 1) (p "validator0" "media" z media)
          (p "validator0" "assertions" z assertions)
          (p "validator0" "gen" z gen) (non (privk gen)))
        (or
          (exists ((z-0 strd))
            (and (p "generator0" z-0 1)
              (p "generator0" "media" z-0 media)
              (p "generator0" "assertions" z-0 assertions)
              (p "generator0" "gen" z-0 gen) (prec z-0 0 z 0)))
          (exists ((z-0 strd))
            (and (p "generator1" z-0 1)
              (p "generator1" "media" z-0 media)
              (p "generator1" "assertions" z-0 assertions)
              (p "generator1" "gen" z-0 gen) (prec z-0 0 z 0)))
          (exists ((z-0 strd))
            (and (p "generator2" z-0 3)
              (p "generator2" "media" z-0 media)
              (p "generator2" "assertions" z-0 assertions)
              (p "generator2" "gen" z-0 gen) (prec z-0 2 z 0)))
          (exists ((z-0 strd))
            (and (p "generator3" z-0 3)
              (p "generator3" "media" z-0 media)
              (p "generator3" "assertions" z-0 assertions)
              (p "generator3" "gen" z-0 gen) (prec z-0 2 z 0)))
          (exists ((z-0 strd))
            (and (p "generator4" z-0 3)
              (p "generator4" "media" z-0 media)
              (p "generator4" "assertions" z-0 assertions)
              (p "generator4" "gen" z-0 gen) (prec z-0 2 z 0)))))))
  (comment "Analysis of Security Goal 1 (SG1)")
  (traces
    ((recv
       (cat media (enc (hash assertions (hash media)) (privk gen))
         assertions (hash media)))))
  (label 0)
  (unrealized (0 0))
  (origs)
  (comment "3 in cohort - 3 not yet seen"))

(defskeleton c2pa
  (vars (media data) (assertions text) (gen name))
  (defstrand validator0 1 (media media) (assertions assertions)
    (gen gen))
  (defstrand generator0 1 (media media) (assertions assertions)
    (gen gen))
  (precedes ((1 0) (0 0)))
  (non-orig (privk gen))
  (operation encryption-test (added-strand generator0 1)
    (enc (hash assertions (hash media)) (privk gen)) (0 0))
  (strand-map 0)
  (traces
    ((recv
       (cat media (enc (hash assertions (hash media)) (privk gen))
         assertions (hash media))))
    ((send
       (cat media (enc (hash assertions (hash media)) (privk gen))
         assertions (hash media)))))
  (label 1)
  (parent 0)
  (realized)
  (shape)
  (satisfies yes)
  (maps ((0) ((media media) (assertions assertions) (gen gen))))
  (origs))

(defskeleton c2pa
  (vars (media data) (assertions time text) (gen tsa name))
  (defstrand validator1 1 (media media) (assertions assertions)
    (time time) (gen gen) (tsa tsa))

    (forall ((media data) (assertions text) (gen tsa name) (z strd))
      (implies
        (and (p "validator1" z 1) (p "validator1" "media" z media)
          (p "validator1" "assertions" z assertions)
          (p "validator1" "gen" z gen) (p "validator1" "tsa" z tsa)
          (non (privk gen)) (non (privk tsa)))
        (or
          (exists ((z-0 strd))
